notes: Gamerz and Streamerz are one joined switch with a sliding highlight, a small icon pop and an inline spinner. The Speed gauge is a slim arc with a reading dot, five labels and the live number in the centre, the needle is gone, and the measuring strip is a full-width bar with a round stop button at the far right. The whole Home Server/App Routing cells and the Speed server card are clickable, and refresh controls no longer change the mouse cursor. Windows experimental build; the phone stays at 0.7.5.
